subject: Quick intake: Redwood demo & capacity details
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha@cloudfin.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@cloudfin.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intake: Redwood demo & capacity details

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — we just created a self-serve account on Redwood and ran a few experiments. The product team at CloudFin (myself + Tom Li, our engineering lead) would like a short walkthrough to understand how Redwood handles production traffic and what the POC path looks like. A few high-level notes: 

- Use case: conversational finance support (transaction classification, short summaries, and context-aware prompts)
- Expected volume: ~1,000 requests/day with spikes to ~200 concurrent requests during US market open
- Avg input length: ~150 tokens, outputs ~70 tokens
- Timeline: aiming for a POC in mid-August; decision by end of Q3

Could you share a short pre-demo checklist and a few times you have available next week? Also attaching a very short initial_scope.xlsx that lists the requirements procurement will ask for — happy to go through this during the demo.

One more thing: we have SOC 2 questions and a brief SLA ask — should I include that in the call or send separately?

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Director of Product
CloudFin, Inc.

Attachment: initial_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)

- Peak concurrency (you mentioned ~200 — is that sustained or 15-30 min bursts?):

- Any restricted data / PII / regulated workloads?
- Success criteria for POC (throughput, latencies, cost targets, accuracy thresholds):
- Procurement timeline and approver (who signs the PO?):

2) Proposed 30–45m demo slots (PDT):
- Wed Jul 16: 10:00–10:45
- Thu Jul 17: 14:00–14:45
- Fri Jul 18: 09:30–10:15

3) Pre-demo materials we usually ask for (optional):
- Small sample of typical prompts and outputs (anonymized)

If you prefer, I can send an invite for the first slot and we can move it later. I also attached a 1-page pre-demo guide link in the calendar invite once we lock a time.

From: Samantha Green <samantha@cloudfin.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@cloudfin.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intake: Redwood demo & capacity details

Hi Priyom — thanks for the fast reply. Answers inline below (bolded where appropriate):

- Primary objective for POC: integration with our transaction pipeline for real-time classification (latency-critical, but correctness is key)
- Peak concurrency: typically 150–220 for 20–45 minute bursts during market open
- Target latency SLO: p95 ~150–200ms, p99 ideally <350ms (we understand p99 is tougher but want to aim for <350ms)
- Preferred model family: open models are preferred but we may test a small fine-tune if results justify it
- Data residency: US-only (no EU data) but we will need encryption-at-rest and key control; private deployment is not required initially
- Restricted data: will include limited PII (masked account numbers), so we need SOC 2 assurances and a data handling overview
- Success criteria: handle bursts without queue build-up, p95 latency <=200ms, acceptable cost per 1k requests
- Procurement timeline: procurement contact is Laura Chen (laura.chen@cloudfin.com); budget approval expected by mid-August

Availability: Wed Jul 16 10:00 PT works best for our team (Tom and I can make that). I attached our SLA list (cloudfin_sla_requirements.pdf) — procurement asked to have that reviewed during the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Attachment: cloudfin_sla_requirements.pdf (PDF)
